/**
 * @internal
 */
type DecoratedQueryMethods<TDef extends ResolverDef> = {
  /**
   * @see https://trpc.io/docs/v11/client/react/useQuery
   */
  useQuery: ProcedureUseQuery<TDef>;
  usePrefetchQuery: ProcedureUsePrefetchQuery<TDef>;
